mechanism: ACE inhibitors combined with MAOIs can cause severe hypertensive crisis due to accumulated sympathomimetic amines and enhanced norepinephrine effects, plus additive hypotensive effects creating unpredictable blood pressure changes.
action: Avoid concurrent use; allow minimum 2-week washout of phenelzine before starting benazepril, or vice versa; if combination unavoidable, use extreme caution with close hemodynamic monitoring.
